description:
## Finding
\`RUSTDOCFLAGS=\"--cfg docsrs -D warnings\" cargo +nightly doc --no-deps --workspace --all-features\` produces 4 errors:

1. \`pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:271\` — \`LintResult\` doc links to private item \`de_static_str\` (rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links)
2. \`pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:508\` — \`Finding\` doc links to private item \`de_static_str\` (same lint)
3. \`pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:99\` — unclosed HTML tag \`<id>\` in \`\"DEVIATION APPLIED by <id>\"\` (rustdoc::invalid_html_tags)
4. \`pkix-lint/src/report.rs:98\` — same \`<id>\` tag

## Why P1
Workspace-wide \`[package.metadata.docs.rs]\` sets \`rustdoc-args = [\"--cfg\", \"docsrs\"]\` and \`all-features = true\`. The docs.rs build for pkix-lint will fail when these errors fire under nightly toolchain conventions.

The cargo-doc invocation is the exact one prescribed by AGENTS.md RustCrypto contribution checklist: \`RUSTDOCFLAGS=\"--cfg docsrs -D warnings\" cargo +nightly doc --no-deps --all-features -p <crate>\`.

## Fix
- For 1 and 2: change \`[\`de_static_str\`]\` references to plain backticks, OR mark them with \`#[allow(rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links)]\` on the items, OR document de_static_str publicly. Plain backticks is simplest.
- For 3 and 4: replace literal \`<id>\` with backticked \`\\\`<id>\\\`\` or escape as \`<id>\`.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:271\`, \`pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:508\`, \`pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:99\`, \`pkix-lint/src/report.rs:98\`.
title: P1: docs.rs build fails — 4 rustdoc errors in pkix-lint with --cfg docsrs -D warnings
